general_feeling_english: Strange, I normally don't wear glasses. However, I do want to buy glasses with a blue light filter so I don’t get discomfort from looking at screens in the dark. But the weight of the sensor on the glasses was sometimes annoying.
challenges_english: The pressure of the glasses on the bridge of my nose; sometimes I chose not to wear the glasses for a while or to put them on top of my head for a bit.
act_impact_english: Mostly due to questions from other people who were curious about what it was and if it wasn’t a camera, and whether I was filming them.
beh_adapt_english: Somewhat, for example I didn’t wear them during a long outdoor shift in hospitality. Otherwise, I tried to wear them as much as possible.
social_english: Definitely, got a lot of questions about what it was. On the street, you were usually looked at strangely by people passing by.
improvements_english: Make the sensor thinner and integrate it into the upper rim of the glasses instead of having a block above your nose.
change_behavior_english: I started to reflect more on how I experienced certain situations throughout the day.
